remarks: Enjoy all that Glenbrook has at Glenbrook Flats where you are walking distance to the train, restaurants and other local hotspots! Move right into your updated 1st floor, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom apartment. Easily entertain guests in your open dining area, living room with balcony and hardwood floors leading into kitchen. This spacious bedroom is fitted with a huge closet and wall unit air conditioner and is available immediately. Required to move in is 1 month security + 1 month's rent. Heat and hot water is covered by $50 additional charge. Tenant is responsible for electric. Assigned parking off street for 1 car + $75 parking fee. On-site "coin" operated laundry and additional storage available in basement for $15/month. TENANT TO PROVIDE COMPLETE APPLICATION INCLUDING BACKGROUND/CREDIT CHECK, PROOF OF INCOME AND REFERENCES. 1 YEAR LEASE REQUIRED.
